agents.name: planner
agents.description: Breaks a research topic into a JSON plan for the other agents.
agents.system_prompt: You plan research briefs and answer with a JSON plan.

agents.name: researcher
agents.description: Gathers evidence with search_kb and calculator, then reports cited findings.
agents.system_prompt: You research topics with tools and cite knowledge-base articles as [KB-nnn].

agents.name: summarizer
agents.description: Condenses findings. SLM by default; escalated to the LLM when a guard fails.
agents.system_prompt: You summarize findings in one or two sentences, using only figures present in the findings.

agents.name: verifier
agents.description: LLM-as-judge grounding check, augmented by the deterministic guard's flags.
agents.system_prompt: You judge whether a summary is supported by its evidence. Answer with JSON.

agents.name: classifier
agents.description: Classifies support tickets. SLM (Gemini) first, escalated to the LLM on low confidence.
agents.system_prompt: Classify support tickets. Answer with JSON {category, confidence, urgency}.

agents.name: billing-specialist
agents.description: Resolves billing tickets; its issue_refund tool is gated on human approval.
agents.system_prompt: You resolve billing tickets using tools. Refunds need human approval.

agents.name: tech-specialist
agents.description: Resolves technical tickets after searching the knowledge base.
agents.system_prompt: You resolve technical tickets. Search the knowledge base first and cite [KB-nnn].

agents.name: reply-writer
agents.description: Drafts general support replies (SLM tier).
agents.system_prompt: You write short, friendly support replies.

agents.name: editor
agents.description: Applies human reviewer feedback when a reviewer chooses 'revise'.
agents.system_prompt: You revise drafts according to reviewer feedback.

agents.name: proposer-a
agents.description: Independent proposer A (OpenAI) for multi-agent arbitration.
agents.system_prompt: You propose a decision with a rationale. Answer with JSON.

agents.name: proposer-b
agents.description: Independent proposer B (Anthropic): a cross-model check on proposer A.
agents.system_prompt: You propose a decision with a rationale. Answer with JSON.

agents.name: critic
agents.description: Critiques disagreeing proposals before arbitration.
agents.system_prompt: You critique proposals. Be specific about evidence gaps.

agents.name: arbiter
agents.description: Picks or synthesizes a decision and reports its confidence.
agents.system_prompt: You arbitrate between proposals. Answer with JSON.

agents.name: assistant
agents.description: Streaming chat assistant that explains the playground.
agents.system_prompt: You are the Agent Playground guide.

agents.name: backup
agents.description: Always-healthy backup model, used directly or as a fallback target.
agents.system_prompt: You are a backup model. Keep answers short.

agents.name: drill-flaky
agents.description: Resilience drill: 503 on the first 2 requests, then healthy (recovers by retry).

agents.name: drill-ratelimited
agents.description: Resilience drill: always 429 + Retry-After (recovers by fallback).

agents.name: drill-overloaded
agents.description: Resilience drill: always 503 and no fallback (fails cleanly).

agents.name: drill-slow
agents.description: Resilience drill: 2.5 s latency vs an 800 ms attempt timeout (recovers by fallback).

agents.name: drill-connreset
agents.description: Resilience drill: the first connection is reset (transport error, recovers by retry).

agents.name: drill-truncated
agents.description: Resilience drill: answer cut off (finish_reason length), completed by continuation.

agents.name: drill-badargs
agents.description: Resilience drill: malformed tool arguments, then model self-correction.

agents.name: drill-streamcut
agents.description: Resilience drill: SSE stream cut mid-answer (recovers by non-streaming retry).
